notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Elemental's power.
Repeat.
